description: Request a recruitment quote for a low-incidence audience on an existing panel study. Provide one target market, the audience criteria, the interview count, and the incidence rate. Check status here or open Recruit participants on the study dashboard to review and approve the quote. Submitting the request does not launch recruitment or charge the account. Reuse idempotency_key after an uncertain response.

country_code.description: An array containing exactly one target country code.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

incident_rate.description: Estimated percentage who qualify, from 0.01 to 9.99 (5 means 5%).

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

study_id.description: UUID of the study, as returned by list_studies.

target.description: Number of completed interviews to recruit, from 1 to 1,000.

target_audience.description: Describe who should qualify, including relevant screening criteria.

name: submit_feasibility_request
title: Submit Feasibility Request
